title: Would an LLM Match into a Residency? Uncertainty, Reasoning and Image Use of Open Language Models on the Spanish MIR Examination
abstract: arXiv:2610.31586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accuracy on medical examinations is common evidence offered for the clinical use of language models, yet a health system that intends to run an open model on its own hardware needs to know considerably more: whether the model recognizes when it is likely to be wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves this ability, whether its correct answers rest on sound clinical reasoning, or whether it actually uses the images it is given. We examine these questions for four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters on the Spanish MIR residency examination, scoring 1,552 questions from eight editions under the exam's own rules. Answering every question, the three larger models would rank among roughly the first 600 to 3,000 candidates, with 41 to 43 specialties still open to them. translated_title: 大语言模型能匹配进入住院医师培训吗？开放语言模型在西班牙MIR考试中的不确定性、推理与图像利用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.31586v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在医学考试中的准确率是支持语言模型临床应用的常见证据，然而一个打算在自己的硬件上运行开放模型的医疗系统需要了解的远不止于此：模型是否知道自己何时可能出错，医学领域的微调能否提升这种能力，它的正确答案是否建立在合理的临床推理之上，以及它是否真的用到了提供给它的图像。我们在西班牙MIR住院医师考试上针对四个参数量从80亿到270亿的开放模型考察了这些问题，按照该考试自身的规则对八届考试共1,552道题目进行评分。在回答所有题目的情况下，三个较大的模型将排在约前600至3,000名考生之间，仍有41至43个专业可供其匹配。然而，放弃作答永远不合算，因为即便是它们最没把握的答案，其正确率也高于25%的盈亏平衡点。医学微调降低了过度自信……
tldr: 该研究按西班牙MIR住院医师考试的官方规则评估了四个开放大语言模型，发现三个较大模型的成绩可排进前600至3,000名并仍能匹配到41至43个专业，但其弃答策略从不划算，医学微调可减少过度自信，而其临床推理与图像利用能力仍存疑。
en_tdlr: Under the official rules of the Spanish MIR residency exam, three of four open LLMs would rank among the top 600–3,000 candidates and still match into 41–43 specialties, though abstention never pays, medical fine-tuning reduces overconfidence, and their clinical reasoning and image use remain questionable.
